page.layout: One printed page: a full-page engraved diagram of the celestial spheres (armillary-style circles with zodiac signs and planetary labels), with handwritten or engraved inscriptions in the upper left, upper right, lower left and lower right corners. No running text block.
page.notes: Engraved diagram with zodiac signs (Cancer, Leo, Virgo, Libra, Scorpio, Sagittarius, Capricorn, Aquarius, Pisces, Aries, Taurus, Gemini) around the rim; letters A to F, C, D, E mark points on the figure; F is a small inset of the four Jovian moons around Jupiter. The inscription in the upper right and the dedication are handwritten-style lettering; the spelling "Qualuor" and "Sansbergius" are as printed/engraved. Readings of the small inscriptions are uncertain where marked by the handwritten style; no page number, running head or catchword is printed.
